subject: Order Form scope realignment & change request — Project Helios
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara.li@heliospay.com>

Cc: procurement@heliospay.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redlines: MSA + Order Form — HeliosPay (Project Helios)

Marcus — thanks again for the sync this morning. We walked through high level scope and our procurement team tagged the attached redlines for the Order Form and SOW. Key asks from HeliosProc: 

1) Capacity: we need to add ~30% baseline capacity for Q4. We proposed a Capacity Top-up line and asked for proration back to Sept 1.
2) Pricing: Helios requests price protection (cap) for the first 12 months of committed capacity or else an annual price escalation cap.
3) Data retention / logs: request to shorten audit log retention from 5yrs to 2yrs and a clearer boundary on log export for regulated data.

Turnaround: procurement needs a legal response within 48 hours to keep the vendor slate for the board review on Friday. Can you confirm feasibility? I've attached: Helios_OrderForm_v2_redline.pdf and Helios_SOW_v1_redline.docx for your legal team.

Thanks —
Sara Li
Head of Procurement, HeliosPay
procurement@heliospay.com

Sara — appreciate the clear list and the files. We can work quickly on this. High-level plan: 

- I'll coordinate with Karthik on commercial concessions (capacity / proration and price protection) and loop in Laura for legal language.
- Karthik: can you run a quick cost impact for a 30% top-up vs a 20% compromise and whether we can do a prorated credit back to Sept 1?
- Laura: primary legal questions I see: (a) is 12-month price cap acceptable from a risk perspective, (b) data retention change (2yrs) — any compliance flags we should raise, (c) any MSA cross-references for an Order Form-level capacity top-up?

Sara — can you confirm the exact capacity SKU they expect to top up (they flagged "baseline GPU hours" but not the specific sku)? Also sharing internal links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7284 and the Drive folder where we put the current redlines: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/heliospay/project-helios/

— Marcus

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:25:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Redlines: MSA + Order Form — Project Helios

Folks — quick commercial read. I ran a sensitivity on the 30% top-up: incremental unit economics look tight at that level given current utilization, but we can do a compromise that should keep Helios happy while limiting downside: 

- Offer a 20% baseline capacity top-up (Exhibit B addendum) effective Sept 1, prorated billing for the rest of Q3, and a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the incremental commit to offset migration / integration run-up.
- For price protection: propose a 6-month price collar (cap at +6% for the first 6 months) instead of a full 12-month cap — gives them predictability, keeps us flexible.
- Data retention: 2yrs is a place we can generally accept, but we should keep the MSA audit clause language that requires 30 days' notice for any log export and confirm any PII exemptions.

Attached is a short change-order draft with the 20% proposal and proration math: proposed_changeorder_draft.pdf.

Laura — can you please: (1) review the change-order and mark MSA cross-refs (we'll need Exhibit B + Order Form update + signature), (2) confirm whether the price collar language below is contract-ready or needs different phrasing:

"The parties agree that for a period of six (6) months following the effective date of the Capacity Addendum, Redwood's unit price for the committed capacity shall not increase by more than six percent (6%) compared to the unit price in effect on the Effective Date."

Happy to jump on a quick sync. Marcus, I'll be available 2pm–4pm PT today if you want to loop in Sara for a short confirmation call.

— Karthik
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): proposed_changeorder_draft.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@heliospay.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Redlines: MSA + Order Form — Project Helios

Thanks — reviewed the redlines and Karthik's proposed change order. Summary of legal position and proposed language: 

1) Capacity top-up: amend Order Form with a Capacity Addendum referencing Exhibit B. Add a short amendment clause in the MSA (Section 7.2) to allow Order Form-level capacity modifications without re-executing the full MSA, provided the Addendum is signed by authorized representatives. I'll prepare the exact exhibit change.

2) Price collar: 6-month collar is acceptable; suggested wording tweak to reduce ambiguity:
"For six (6) months from the Effective Date of the Capacity Addendum, Redwood shall not increase the unit price for committed capacity by more than six percent (6%) from the unit price in effect on the Effective Date. Any increase shall be communicated in writing no fewer than thirty (30) days prior to implementation."

3) Data retention / logs: accepting 2-year retention with the caveat that we need to carve out export rights for regulated PII where Helios warrants they will provide any required consent or redacted datasets. Also recommend preserving our audit timing (45 days notice) and limit on scope to systems used for billing and security investigations only.

4) Execution path: because Helios needs this on the board pack, we can produce a pre-filled Change Order (Exhibit B + signature block) and route to DocuSign. Recommend we: (a) finalize commercial terms (Marcus/Karthik confirm), (b) Laura to produce the contract language (I'll attach a snippet), (c) Marcus to confirm the exact sku and signatory.

I've attached the legal snippet for Section 7 language: MSA_section_7_amendment_snippet.txt. I'm comfortable with the proposed compromise (20% + 6-month collar + prorated billing + onboarding credit) as long as Helios confirms the sku and signs the Addendum.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): MSA_section_7_amendment_snippet.txt
